description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git receive-pack and related configurations, particularly focusing on input limits, unpack limits, and push behaviors.

methods.name: validate_store_type
methods.description: Validates the current store type by checking object counts after a push, depending on whether the store type is 'index' or 'unpack'.

methods.name: test_pack_input_limit
methods.description: Conducts a series of tests setting different input limits and verifying the push and store behaviors for each limit type.
